resources.string: Rebuild library and history from Simkl
Upload local items first, fetch a full Simkl snapshot, then remove verified local records.

This uploads local library items and completed viewing history to your connected Simkl account, verifies a fresh download, and switches both sources to Simkl. It does not restore a local backup. Local resume positions, custom progress settings, or unmatched items stop the operation before deletion. Uploads already accepted by Simkl remain if a later step fails.
Uploading and verifying. Keep this screen open.
Uploaded and verified. Library and history now come from Simkl.
Local resume positions or custom progress settings cannot be restored exactly from Simkl. Nothing was uploaded or deleted.
Finish pending library changes before reimporting. Nothing was deleted.
Some items cannot be matched safely in Simkl. No local records were deleted.
Simkl has not returned all uploaded items yet. Retry later. No local records were deleted.
Reimport did not finish. Uploaded items remain in Simkl. Check your connection and account, then retry.
